WITH media_type_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM MediaType mt
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM media_type_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(mtm.avg_unit_price) AS average_of_average_unit_prices,
  AVG(mtm.bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  AVG(mtm.bytes_per_millisecond - ar.avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate_above_cross_media_type_average
FROM media_type_metrics mtm
CROSS JOIN average_rate ar
WHERE mtm.bytes_per_millisecond > ar.avg_bytes_per_millisecond;
